title: Disney Wins Property Tax Litigation for Magic Kingdom Resorts
summary: Disney has settled six years of property tax lawsuits over the Grand Floridian, Polynesian, and Contemporary, and the agreements cut the Orange County Property Appraiser’s values for the first two resorts by more than $767 million. Judge Margaret H. Schreiber signed all six judgments this week, along with orders dismissing five other Disney tax cases. […]
